preview.text: The Titans won the toss and chose to bat first in the T20 match against the Eastern Storm at SuperSport Park. Across the 91 recorded T20 matches at SuperSport Park, the usual first-innings score is 164. The forecast for the next 8 hours indicates up to a 0 per cent chance of rain and about 18 degrees.

summary.text: Titans won by 99 runs. TIT made 260-4, Dewald Brevis top-scoring with 83 off 26 balls; Juan Lubbe took 1 for 25. ESTORM made 120-5, Kabelo Sekhukhune top-scoring with 41 off 26 balls; Tabraiz Shamsi took 2 for 12. Sides batting first at SuperSport Park usually make about 164.
